liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Uncle John's Band** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Listener hears a Supplication tease, mostly from Jerry, in the second jam of Uncle John's Band; Reviewer confirms Jerry's Supplication phrase against the seven-beat backdrop of the Uncle John's jam [3][18][19][20]
- **Cosmic Charlie Tease** (3 reviews): Audience audibly sighs with disappointment when the Cosmic Charlie tease turns out to lead into Wharf Rat; The Cosmic Charlie tease is described as a strange time warp [9][10][11]
- **Corrina** (1 review, 1 other source): Corrina was better than usual, and the jam after it into drums was very good; Uploader recommends listening to Phil's bass line in Corrina [3][20]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 other source): Final chorus lacks 'back to'; present on both sources, so it was performed that way [1]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Attendee expected the jam to become Cosmic Charlie, but it swerved into Wharf Rat, leaving disappointment [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Cosmic Charlie Tease**: back after 722 archived shows (3593 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-02-27.mtx.tetzeli.32637.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 176 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1994-02-27.mtx.tetzeli.fix-32637.92803.reflac.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 176 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1994-02-27.sbd.miller.32577.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 176 min; rated 2.5/5 by 6 [3]. Said about its sound: Apparent dropouts in the soundboard are actually a noise gate, not cuts [3]
- **gd94-02-27.aud.wankelsworth.12097.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 176 min; rated 2.29/5 by 7 [4]
- **gd94-02-27.sbd.stephens.5972.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 169 min; rated 3.7/5 by 10 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard recording excellent for 1994; Soundboard copy came from a cassette and has audible tape hiss; Soundboard has some hiss, though reviewer says it is cleaner and less than in earlier years [10][12][13]

## Around the show

- Dragon displays impressed; a huge white dragon flew across the stadium [14]
- Third night opened with an eight-armed dancer; during Space, two dragons represented a duel of light and darkness [15]
- Reviewer bought a ticket from a security guard and entered during Samson and Delilah [20]
- Occasional audience comments can be heard through the music on this matrix [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-02-27.mtx.tetzeli.32637.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD(32577) + AUD(12097) [1]
- **gd1994-02-27.mtx.tetzeli.fix-32637.92803.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Matrix (SBD/AUD mixdown), done in Cool Edit Pro (reseed). [2]. Also: Matrix first set was redone after an antispyware scan caused stuttering while time-stretching the audience source; second set was unaffected [2]
- **gd1994-02-27.sbd.miller.32577.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) D [3]
- **gd94-02-27.aud.wankelsworth.12097.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by H. Wankleswurth; source: Audience: Unknown Mics [4]. Also: Audience recording, microphones unknown, to DAT then CDR, via H. Wankleswurth, seeded to etree by candyman [4]
- **gd94-02-27.sbd.stephens.5972.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD> CM(?)> DAT [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Michael Mullen Grateful Dead: [1994-02-25 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-02-25-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [22]
